title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 DNSSEC Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, focused adapter tests, DNS package build, SpecTrace validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9463 DNSSEC policy surface.
scope: This verification covers accepting secure DNSSEC validation for ADN-only SVCB-derived resolver parameters, rejecting insecure, bogus, indeterminate, or missing DNSSEC validation outcomes, and consuming DNSSEC status from a deterministic validator adapter.
preconditions: The caller supplies the DNSSEC validation status from a resolver stack outside Incursa.Quic.Dns.
The policy is applied only to RFC 9463 ADN-only SVCB resolution.
expected_result: The focused DNSSEC policy tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9463 artifacts, generated triage remains trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9463 ADN-only DNSSEC policy is trace-owned and verified. Live DNSSEC validation, provider publication/signing, host resolver installation, and encrypted DNS session establishment remain adapter or operational work.
